description: One case's full record chain in time order: the case lifecycle records (Incident Finding 2005: open/update/close) and the agent evidence pins (Datastore Activity 6005, Query) from investigations.records through the ocsf-clickhouse datasource. Every row carries the record_integrity attestation columns — the record's fingerprint and the prev_event fingerprint it references — so chain continuity is visible per record (chained / chain genesis / restart gap / pre-epoch; the investigations-attest-verify walk alerts on actual breaks). The time window bounds which records appear; case_uid picks the case.

panels.description: The case's records in time order: lifecycle records (class 2005) and evidence pins (class 6005) with the pinned query text and a snapshot excerpt. agent is the ai_operation stamp (ai_agent.name) with metadata.product.name as fallback. The chain column reads the attestation: chained rows reference the previous record's fingerprint; chain genesis / restart gap carry no prev_event (the documented restart semantics); rows predating the attestation epoch have no fingerprint at all.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  event.class_uid.:Int64 AS class_uid,
  event.activity_name.:String AS activity,
  coalesce(event.query_info.query_string.:String, '') AS query,
  coalesce(substring(arrayStringConcat(event.query_info.data[], ', '), 1, 256), '') AS snapshot,
  coalesce(event.ai_agent.name.:String, event.metadata.product.name.:String) AS agent,
  CASE event.severity_id.:Int64
    WHEN 6 THEN '6 Fatal' WHEN 5 THEN '5 Critical' WHEN 4 THEN '4 High' WHEN 3 THEN '3 Medium'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2 Low' WHEN 1 THEN '1 Informational' ELSE '0 Unknown' END AS severity,
  CASE event.status_id.:Int64
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 New' WHEN 2 THEN '2 In Progress' WHEN 3 THEN '3 On Hold' WHEN 4 THEN '4 Resolved'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5 Closed' ELSE '' END AS status,
  multiIf(
    length(event.attestation_list[].fingerprint.value.:String) = 0, 'no attestation (pre-epoch)',
    isNull(event.attestation_list[].prev_event.fingerprint.value.:String[1]),
      if(event.class_uid.:Int64 = 2005 AND event.activity_id.:Int64 = 1, 'chain genesis', 'restart gap'),
    'chained') AS chain,
  event.attestation_list[].fingerprint.value.:String[1] AS fingerprint,
  event.attestation_list[].prev_event.fingerprint.value.:String[1] AS prev_fingerprint
FROM investigations.records
WHERE event.metadata.correlation_uid.:String = ${case_uid:singlequote}
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Record timeline

panels.description: The observables riding the case's evidence pins (envelope observables, one row per entry): the OCSF observable path, its value, type_id, and the raw lake rows (event_uid links) the pinned snapshot came from.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  name AS observable,
  value,
  type_id,
  lake_rows
FROM investigations.records
ARRAY JOIN
  event.observables[].name.:String AS name,
  event.observables[].value.:String AS value,
  event.observables[].type_id.:Int64 AS type_id,
  event.observables[].event_uid.:String AS lake_rows
WHERE event.metadata.correlation_uid.:String = ${case_uid:singlequote}
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
